title: All-in-One Memory: Process-Rewarded Reinforcement Learning for Memory Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.21147v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models increasingly rely on external memory to answer queries grounded in long-horizon histories such as multi-session dialogues and lengthy documents. However, existing memory methods often optimize retrieval and memory construction separately, without a shared reward space for evaluating search, writing, and stopping decisions. To address this, we propose All-in-One Memory (AiO-Mem), which organizes these operations as transitions over a shared evidence state and directly evaluates the semantic quality of each action in a unified reward space. AiO-Mem compiles heterogeneous histories into source-traceable multi-view events, providing a shared substrate for retrieval and memory writing. A unified memory policy actor then rolls out complete interaction trajectories over this shared evidence state. translated_title: All-in-One Memory（一体化记忆）：面向记忆智能体的过程奖励强化学习
translated_abstract: 大语言模型越来越依赖外部记忆来回答基于长时程历史（如多轮会话和长篇文档）的问题。然而，现有的记忆方法通常将检索和记忆构建分开优化，缺乏一个用于评估搜索、写入和停止决策的共享奖励空间。为解决这一问题，我们提出了All-in-One Memory（AiO-Mem），它将这些操作组织为共享证据状态上的状态转移，并在统一的奖励空间中直接评估每个动作的语义质量。AiO-Mem将异构历史信息编译为可溯源的多视角事件，为检索和记忆写入提供了共享基础。随后，统一的记忆策略actor在该共享证据状态上展开完整的交互轨迹。一个独立的以轨迹为条件的过程奖励模型则通过基于证据的监督微调和轨迹（原文在此处截断）……
tldr: 该论文提出AiO-Mem框架，将记忆智能体的检索、写入与停止决策统一建模为共享证据状态上的转移，并通过过程奖励强化学习在统一奖励空间中直接评估每个动作的语义质量。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes AiO-Mem, which unifies the retrieval, writing, and stopping decisions of memory agents as transitions over a shared evidence state, and evaluates the semantic quality of each action through process-rewarded reinforcement learning in a unified reward space.
